primaryText: All the girls were wearing hats.
context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: A neutral context reading: each girl wears a single hat (p. 432). Dependent plural under a plural quantificational DP.

context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: Implies that each girl was wearing more than one hat (p. 432).

primaryText: All the girls were wearing several hats.
context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: Entails that each girl was wearing more than one hat (p. 432).

primaryText: The girls were wearing several hats.
context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: Allows a cumulative interpretation on which each girl wears at least one hat (p. 433).

primaryText: Most of the girls were wearing hats.
context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: Judged true relative to a situation in which a majority of the girls were each wearing one or more hats, more than one hat overall (p. 435); the context is such a situation.

primaryText: The girls were all wearing hats.
context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: Dependent plural licensed by floating all (p. 435).

context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: Entails that each girl was wearing more than one hat (p. 436).

primaryText: The girls were each wearing hats.
context: Each girl was wearing a single hat, and no two girls were wearing the same hat.
comment: Entails that each girl was wearing more than one hat (p. 436); floating each.
